requiredPrograms.title: Browser-level Repair and Resume fault injection
Frozen and discarded page lifecycle research and recovery
Long-conversation observation, scanning, rendering, timer, and constrained-device performance
Host-affixed mobile Ghost shell research, implementation, and certification
Canonical build, candidate, and release-channel identity
Architecture, README, help, changelog, protocol, and orchestration-policy reconciliation
Full certification, release audit, package, and SHA-256 verification

explicitLimits: The grouped assistant query remains history-linear.
The safety-critical begin-Send and send-evidence observation path remains history-linear at 8004 assistant-selector matches/sample at 2000 turns.
No proof Ghost dominates total host-page lag.
Pixel-7 Playwright evidence is emulation, not physical Android certification.
Desktop Firefox evidence is not Firefox-Android/GeckoView certification.
Hosted-CI timing is not a calibrated low-end hardware budget.
priorRound.sequencingDecision: DQ-R4-LIFECYCLE-REVIEW and DQ-R5-LONGCHAT-REVIEW remain local under canonical Policy B. Independent reversible MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURAL work may continue.

roundHypotheses.claim: An adapter-owned explicit structural mount contract can add one Ghost child/sibling to a verified host row or stack with lower safety and maintenance risk than generic DOM inference.
roundHypotheses.prediction: A deterministic ChatGPT host fixture and current live DOM mapping can identify stable header/composer/footer anchors, preserve the original Send node, and survive host-control insertion/rerender using only scoped observation.

roundHypotheses.claim: A reusable ancestor-climb and layout-classification algorithm may reduce per-adapter selector maintenance while still discovering safe flex/grid/block/table mount points.
roundHypotheses.prediction: The same inference rules should select the intended container across materially different fixture structures without wrapping, reordering, hiding, or overlapping host controls; otherwise the approach is rejected for first implementation.

roundHypotheses.claim: The existing fixed composer rail should remain a compatibility fallback rather than being rewritten until structural verification succeeds.
roundHypotheses.prediction: When a structural contract cannot prove normal-flow insertion and Send-node preservation, the attempted mount can cleanly unmount and the existing rail can continue without new actuation authority.

roundHypotheses.claim: A standard custom element with Shadow DOM can isolate Ghost internals while the host element itself remains an in-flow child or sibling.
roundHypotheses.prediction: Isolation can be achieved without scoped CustomElementRegistry dependencies, fixed/absolute positioning for the structural mount, or duplicated Ghost state/action authority.

dispatch.instruction: Claim R6-A1-MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURE-MAP regardless of timer number. Map current ChatGPT mobile/desktop host structure, compare explicit adapter contracts against generic structural inference and the rail fallback, gather upstream/adoption/user evidence, create deterministic structure fixtures when useful, and predeclare the smallest first structural candidate plus falsification gate. Do not change product behavior.

assignments.goal: Open the next evidence-competitive round for the user-required host-affixed mobile Ghost shell without treating deferred Round-4 or Round-5 reviews as global freezes.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the mobile-shell brief and current implementation before defining work
Preserve Round-5 bounded certification and its explicit linear/physical-platform limits
Keep DQ-R4-LIFECYCLE-REVIEW and DQ-R5-LONGCHAT-REVIEW local under Policy B
Open Round 6 on MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURAL with an evidence-competitive research/build/Red-Team/mobile/audit chain
Only the earliest dependency-ready Round-6 assignment is activated
All remaining release-critical programs remain present

assignments.goal: Map real host structural rows/columns for ChatGPT first, falsify competing discovery strategies, and define the smallest one-platform/one-mode structural candidate without changing product behavior.
assignments.mandatoryAction: Use repository source plus current authoritative platform/web standards and relevant user/community/adoption evidence where available. Compare at least explicit adapter-owned mount contracts, generic structural inference, and the existing rail fallback. Evaluate teal, blue, and red for the first ChatGPT implementation; do not preselect based only on the brief sketch.
prohibitedActions: production shell implementation before a reproduced structural map and falsification gate
moving, wrapping, cloning, replacing, or intercepting host Send
viewport overlay as success for blue or red
document-wide high-frequency MutationObserver for the proposed structural mount
acceptanceCriteria: Record current ChatGPT header action row, composer action row, composer/footer stack, layout type, stable anchors, and replacement/rerender behavior at desktop and narrow mobile breakpoints using live evidence or a clearly labeled deterministic fixture when live inspection is unavailable

Record current Ghost baseline: fixed #gitl panel/rail geometry, document-body rail observer/polling, platform adapter fields, and absence/presence of existing custom-element/Shadow-DOM structural infrastructure
Compare explicit adapter-owned contracts versus generic structural inference with measurable failure predictions, maintenance cost, and safety consequences
Evaluate teal, blue, and red as the first implementation candidate using reach/usability, Send proximity, layout reflow, narrow-width, rerender, and reversibility evidence
Gather primary/upstream/adoption evidence and aggregate user/community evidence when it can discriminate; mark unavailable evidence UNKNOWN
Create deterministic host-structure fixtures or probes sufficient to reproduce the selected mount assumptions without actuating Send
Predeclare the smallest build candidate plus exact structural/safety/performance falsification criteria for A2
No product behavior changes
requiredTests: source inspection of #gitl positioning, rail tracking, platform adapters, and Send selectors
deterministic host-structure probe/fixture if live host evidence cannot be made durable
exact command/head/run/job/artifact for any CI execution
assignments.fallbackWork: If current ChatGPT structure cannot be reliably mapped, commit only a deterministic capture/probe fixture and create the smallest exact-evidence recovery assignment; do not guess selectors or authorize product implementation.

assignments.goal: Implement only the A1-selected one-platform/one-mode structural mount primitive behind an experimental path, preserving the existing rail as fail-closed compatibility fallback.
prohibitedActions: implementing more than one platform and one mount mode unless A1 evidence makes them inseparable
fixed or absolute positioning for the structural mount element
new Send/Play authority or second state store
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the smallest A1-selected adapter-owned structural mount and only its required registry/verification infrastructure
The structural host element is an in-flow child or sibling; blue/red may not be viewport overlays
Any custom element/Shadow DOM interior reuses existing Ghost state and reviewed action handlers
Host Send remains the exact same connected node before and after mount and stays operable
One data-gitl-mount identity prevents duplicates across rerender/repair
Only the nearest verified structural container is observed for repair; all observers/timers are cleaned on unmount
Every host style mutation is minimal, reversible, and restored exactly
Verification failure removes the attempted structural mount and preserves the existing rail fallback
Generated userscript/extension parity remains exact
A1 falsification gates pass without weakening thresholds or assertions
requiredTests: A1 structural fixture/probe on exact candidate head
full unit suite when product source changes
record exact command/head/run/job/artifact when CI is used
assignments.fallbackWork: Any structural, Send-identity, duplicate, cleanup, or falsification failure must block A2 and create the smallest ready A2X repair/execution recovery rather than weakening the contract.

assignments.goal: Falsify the structural mount under host control insertion, subtree replacement, route changes, layout pressure, verification failure, and cleanup while proving Send/CHOICE/route/lease/uncertainty remain fail closed.
prohibitedActions: accepting a blocked builder as a pass
product changes except a supervisor-created bounded recovery
weakening structural or Send identity assertions
acceptanceCriteria: Insert native host controls before and after Ghost and verify host controls remain present, ordered, visible, and operable
Replace the relevant host subtree repeatedly and verify exactly one Ghost mount with the same Ghost state

Verify original Send node identity and event behavior are unchanged; zero Ghost test instrumentation may submit/click/input/keydown the host Send path unless the existing reviewed regression explicitly requires it
Force missing/malformed/fixed-grid/overflow structural candidates and verify structural verification fails closed to clean unmount/rail fallback rather than overlap
Exercise route changes and stale-node replacement without duplicate observers/mounts
Verify unmount restores every recorded host inline style/value exactly
For red-like expansion if selected, prove content reflows and latest message/composer remain reachable rather than covered
Record observer callback/resource accumulation and any reattachment race
requiredTests: focused existing Send transaction and answer/route/lease regressions
unchanged A1/A2 falsification gate where applicable
requiredEvidence: host control and Send identity results
assignments.fallbackWork: Every reproducible failure creates the smallest ready repair assignment with exact fixture state and reproduction command. Do not skip directly to mobile certification.

assignments.goal: Measure the surviving structural candidate under narrow/mobile, keyboard, orientation, large-text, reduced-motion, browser, and constrained-runtime conditions without promoting emulation to physical-device certification.
prohibitedActions: inventing a low-end hardware budget after seeing results
weakening Send or structural assertions for timing
acceptanceCriteria: Exercise Pixel-class Chromium emulation plus a portable Firefox project without Chromium-only mobile options

Test narrow widths including <=500 CSS px, portrait/landscape transitions, visualViewport/keyboard-like changes, browser toolbar movement fixtures, 200% text or equivalent large-text pressure, and prefers-reduced-motion
Verify structural mount remains in flow, host composer/Send/latest message remain reachable, and no host control overlap or clipping is introduced
Measure mount/repair latency, observer callbacks, ResizeObserver activity, layout-shift or geometry deltas, active timers/observers, and duplicate mounts across repeated changes
Use throttled or otherwise constrained CI evidence when useful but label hosted timing descriptive rather than calibrated physical hardware
Preserve zero unintended Send-adjacent actuation and exact fallback behavior
Record physical-device/GeckoView evidence as UNKNOWN unless actually executed
assignments.fallbackWork: A deterministic mobile/layout failure creates the smallest ready repair assignment; preserve the failure and do not convert emulation into a physical-platform claim.

assignments.goal: Independently audit the bounded Round-6 one-platform/one-mode structural prototype, source/evidence bindings, fail-closed behavior, mobile/accessibility limits, and maintenance cost before deciding whether a cross-adapter expansion round is justified.
prohibitedActions: marking MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURAL fully complete before required cross-adapter expansion/final program audit
accepting overlay behavior as structural success
promoting emulation to physical Android/GeckoView certification
acceptanceCriteria: Independently inspect exact source diff and prove the structural mount is in normal host flow
Verify exact-head CI/run/job/artifact bindings for A1/A2/A3/A4 and reject chat-only claims
Verify original Send node identity, CHOICE/route/lease/uncertainty fail-closed behavior, unique mount identity, clean unmount, scoped observation, and exact host-style restoration
Challenge maintenance risk against the current rail fallback and the user-accessibility benefit
Reject unsupported physical-device, GeckoView, universal-selector, or cross-adapter claims
If the bounded ChatGPT prototype is supported, keep MOBILE-SHELL-STRUCTURAL active and expose the next cross-adapter expansion supervisor/research assignment; otherwise expose the smallest recovery
Do not silently resolve DQ-R4-LIFECYCLE-REVIEW or DQ-R5-LONGCHAT-REVIEW
requiredEvidence: explicit next cross-adapter or recovery action
assignments.fallbackWork: Any missing or contradictory evidence creates the smallest ready recovery assignment; do not certify the bounded prototype merely because all scheduled slots fired.
